annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Offices of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, NDRC, Ministry of Finance and the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration on Implementing the 2025 Agricultural Machinery Scrapping and Renewal Subsidy Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs General Office; National Development and Reform Commission General Office; Ministry of Finance General Office; National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration Office
named_instruments_referenced: 国发〔2024〕7号 Action Plan for Large-Scale Equipment Renewal and Trade-in of Consumer Goods
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial notice (Nongbanji [2025] No. 3) extending 2025 subsidies for scrapping and replacing old agricultural machinery. It adds plant-protection drones, field operation monitoring terminals, rice seedling throwers and other machines to the scheme, raises subsidy rates for Beidou-assisted driving systems and drones, and funds the scheme with ultra-long special treasury bonds.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds rice seedling throwers, field monitoring terminals, plant-protection drones, grain dryers, colour sorters and mills to the scrapping subsidy scope
Provinces may raise their self-selected eligible machinery categories from 6 to 12
Scrapping subsidies for Beidou-assisted driving systems, monitoring terminals and plant-protection drones raised by 50%, conditional on buying the same type of new equipment
Purchase subsidy for monitoring terminals capped at 30% of the previous year's average market price
Policy applies from 1 January to 31 December 2025; provinces must report implementation by 10 January 2026
